design_philosophy: Monochrome, 1px hard-rule architecture, Unbounded display headers, JetBrains Mono body & terminal code. Procedural ASCII motion with zero fluff, compact 30/70 synchronized product proof, and strict deduplication across 16+ ICP industries.

typography.instructions: Use Unbounded for main titles, Unbounded/JetBrains Mono for subheadings. Never default to Inter or Arial for headlines. Letter spacing for headlines must be tracking-tight.

colors.instructions: Monochrome palette (pure black #000000, dark void #0a0a0a, card surface #111111, crisp white text #ffffff). No generic full-screen gradients. Tinted grays only.

visual_enhancers.shadows: None or minimal 1px crisp inset border line. Soft blur shadows are strictly prohibited.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none (0px sharp corners). Pill buttons (rounded-full) allowed only for primary action CTAs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#333333] for sticky header. Never fully transparent without blur/scrim.

grids.30_70_split: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-10 gap-6 lg:gap-8 min-h-[620px]
grids.left_rail: col-span-1 lg:col-span-3 sticky top-20 flex flex-col gap-6
grids.right_product_mockup: col-span-1 lg:col-span-7 relative flex flex-col justify-center items-center scale-95 lg:scale-[0.88] transform-gpu origin-top-left
grids.bento_proof: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 p-6 border border-[#333333]

rules: NO spring bounce or elastic overshoot.
Animations MUST only use transform and opacity.
Transitions MUST be element-specific, NEVER transition: all.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA / AAA monochrome high contrast (21:1 black/white)
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and informational elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='industry-selector-item-healthcare').
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Visible focus rings, tab order compliance across all 8 AHI desktop surfaces.

3d_libraries.canvas_rendering: HTML5 2D Canvas procedural ASCII fields (Binary Hands, AHI Eye, Ocean Wave, MacBook live terminal code).
3d_libraries.implementation: Lightweight custom Canvas loops with requestAnimationFrame, zero heavy external 3D bundle bloat.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure /app/design_guidelines.json is strictly valid raw JSON.
Synchronize 30% left storyline narrative with 70% right MacBook product screen across all 16+ ICP industries.
Support the 8 real AHI surfaces: Home, Library, Chat, Apps, Code, Browser, Computer, Teamspaces.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never add fake endorsement claims; use explicit modelled-scenario wording.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
